title: 開放型の冷蔵陳列ケース
description: 店舗や駅売店向けの空の冷蔵陳列ケース。4段の棚、価格差し、断熱側板、上部・下部の通風部、背面点検板と接地脚を造形。商品、冷却・排水・照明・温度表示の動作はなく、食品衛生や電気安全の基準適合を検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.210 × 2.025 × 0.797 m、13,940三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An empty open-front refrigerated display for shops and station kiosks, with four shelves, blank price strips, insulated sides, upper/lower ventilation details, rear access and adjustable feet. No goods, cooling, drainage, powered lights or active temperature display is supplied; food hygiene and electrical-safety compliance are not validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.210 × 2.025 × 0.797 m; 13,940 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
